Our one-on-one physical therapy clinic is a full service facility specializing in Pelvic Health • Women’s and Men’s Health • Manual Therapy • Spine Care • Orthopedics • Sports Medicine • Neurological

What makes us different from those BIG Physical Therapy clinics:
- 1:1 Patient to therapist ratio, your Physical Therapist's focus is 100% on you!
- Private Treatment Rooms
- Women's Health Specialists
- Certified Manual Therapists
- Combined 95+ years experience
- Access to personal exercises online
- Participating with most major health insurance plans including full cooperation with Tricare for our Military families!
- Free Community Lectures
- Privately and locally owned

Only Smart Body Physical Therapy has the patients who travel near and far for our breadth of expertise in pelvic health medicine so that they can savor life again...or perhaps for the first time ever!
